title: Gaussian Integration by Parts for Polynomials
statement:
For every real polynomial $p$, integration against the standard Gaussian probability measure $\gamma$ satisfies
\[
\int_{\mathbb R}p'(x)\,d\gamma(x)=\int_{\mathbb R}x p(x)\,d\gamma(x).
\]
